summary_zh: 免费开源的文件转换工具：按住按键拖拽文件到光标处的环形菜单，即可在本地离线转换图片、PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HWP/HWPX、音视频、电子书、压缩包等格式，文件不上传，也不需要安装 Office。
audience_zh: 适合需要频繁在多种文档、图片、音视频、电子书、压缩包格式间转换的用户，尤其是注重隐私、希望离线处理且电脑未装 Office、Hancom Office 或 LibreOffice 的人；提供 Windows、macOS 预览版和 Linux 版本。

evidence.quote: Free, open-source file converter. Convert 263 formats offline by drag & drop — images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP/HWPX, video, audio, e-books and archives. No upload, no Office needed.
Hold a key (<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>, <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS), drag files and drop them on a format in the donut that opens at your cursor.
Images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP, e-books, archives, fonts, CAD, 3D models and geospatial data work without Office, Hancom Office or LibreOffice.
Filee works offline and saves the result next to the original.
